# Redaction corpora (synthetic)

Generated by `python tools/gen_redaction_corpus.py` (fixed seed). **Every value is random and
fake** — card numbers only satisfy the Luhn checksum and a network prefix, keys only match the
providers' formats. Nothing here belongs to a person or account.

- `secrets.jsonl`: one example per line with the secrets it contains. Stage 1 criterion: 100 %
  of them redacted.
- `clean.txt`: realistic non-secret lines (order/tracking/invoice ids, hashes, UUIDs, prices,
  dates, prose that mentions tokens, passwords, OTPs). Together with the 80 synthetic screen texts
  in `evals/extraction/items/`, Stage 1 criterion: at most 2 % of clean documents get any redaction.

Test: `cargo test -p tsr-guard --test redaction_corpus -- --nocapture`.
